description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities check: is a CVE (or up to 100) in CISA's KEV catalog, with date added, federal remediation due date, past-due flag, known ransomware use, required action and CWEs. Or search the catalog by vendor/product, recently added (?days=) or ransomware use. Complements /v1/cve-lookup (NVD). Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cisa-kev

days.description: Search: added in the last N days (1-3650)

ransomware.description: Search: only entries with known ransomware campaign use
